spans.s: A herd, flock, multitude, a large number or troop (as of beasts); स्त्रीरत्नेषु ममो- र्वशी प्रियतमा यूथे तवेयं वशा
; Ś.5.5. -Comp. -चारिन् a. going about in troops (as monkeys).
नाथः, पः, पतिः the leader of a troop or band.
the head of a flock or herd (usually of elephants), a lordly elephant; मृगेन्द्रविक्रीडितयूथपा इव
. -परिभ्रष्ट a. fallen out from a herd. -बन्धः a flock, herd, troop. -मुख्यः the chief of a troop or herd (as of elephants &c.).
यूथिका [yūthikā] यूथी [yūthī], यूथी A kind of jasmine or its flower; यूथिकाशबलकेशी
Belonging to a troop or herd (at the end of comp.); सिंहेन क्रुद्धेन यथाश्वयूथ्या महाबला भीम- बलेन तद्वत्
Belonging to a herd or flock, being at the head of a herd. -थ्या A herd, flock.
